purpose: Teach: あきらめる/リーズナブル/数時間/いえよ/一遍/しきりに/たいして/そのうえ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お店の改装、あきらめるのはまだ早いわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi, giving up on the renovations now would be a mistake. You have more in you than that.
lines.style: Calm certainty, almost meditative. Slow, measured cadence. Speaking from observation, not judgment. Warm undercurrent—she believes this.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューはリーズナブルな価格設定にしようね、メイちゃん
lines.en: And Aoi, let's make sure the new menu stays reasonably priced. That matters.
lines.style: Gentle directive. Thoughtful pause before speaking. Light emphasis on the principle itself—not commanding, collaborating. Soft finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、数時間お店でお過ごしになったわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: You noticed how that customer spent hours in the shop today, didn't you? That's what matters.
lines.style: Reflective, almost conversational. Drawing out what Aoi already knows. Warm recognition. Trailing upward slightly—inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様に「ごゆっくり」っていえよって、心の中で思うよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I find myself wanting to tell every customer: take your time. Stay as long as you need. That's what I think in my heart.
lines.style: Quiet, intimate confession. Slower pace. Vulnerability beneath the surface. Her voice softens on 'my heart'—genuine tenderness.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、一遍お試しいただきましょうね、メイちゃん
lines.en: Why don't we have Aoi try the new menu herself first? Just once, to really taste it.
lines.style: Gentle suggestion, not command. Thoughtful cadence. Slight warmth on 'herself'—she's thinking of Aoi's experience, not the task.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、お客様、しきりに窓の外を見てらしたわよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Aoi kept looking out the window today, did you notice? She seemed somewhere else.
lines.style: Soft observation, gentle concern underneath. No accusation—just noticing what matters. Trailing downward slightly, like a question she's asking herself.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、新メニューは、たいして手間がかからないわ、メイちゃん
lines.en: The good news is the new menu doesn't ask for much—it won't tire you out.
lines.style: Reassuring, practical. Light warmth on the opening. Almost matter-of-fact but with care underneath. Steady, grounded tone.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、新メニュー、おいしい。そのうえ、見た目も可愛いね、メイちゃん
lines.en: The new menu tastes wonderful. And it looks lovely, too—really charming.
lines.style: Genuine pleasure in her voice. Bright but not effusive. Light, easy delivery. A satisfied nod in the tone. Warm smile at the end.
